text:
nina: Quick design QA from today's console pass — dark-mode legend reads too flat at small sizes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-swatch. Screenshot attached.
sam: Noted. The darkest stop (#061019) pretty much disappears against page bg at 16px. We should either lift it or add a 1px inner stroke.
anya: Can we avoid using words like 'hot' in the legend? Suggest explicit ranges and a short caption for exported images.
joy: Accessibility: small legend text needs 4.5:1. Current label #9aa9b7 on bg #061019 is ~3.9:1. Options: increase text color to #c4d5e3 or use semibold weight. Also add non-color cue for <=5% bucket (dots or hatch) for colorblind users.
sam: Quick options: A) lift darkest stop to #0b1220 + thin stroke, B) keep stops and add dotted pattern for lowest bin. Which should we prototype?
anya: Prototype both in Figma. I'll run a tiny A/B with metrics. Copy change: legend labels -> "Rare (0-5%)", "Occasional (6-20%)", "Common (21-60%)", "Frequent (>60%)". Include caption under exported assets.
joy: Tooltips: bump opacity to 0.92, add 2px shadow, ensure tooltip text >=12px and include "%" unit. Keyboard focus: visible ring (3px solid #2563eb) and aria-labels like "Row 3, Col 5: 4%". Exports: SVGs need <title> and <desc>.
design-bot: Auto-contrast-check: proposed legend text #c4d5e3 on bg #061019 => contrast 5.1:1. Small text AA pass.
sam: I'll post two Figma frames (stroke vs pattern) and small legend previews at 32px and 16px. Also will add CSS stub for canvas-export patterns.
anya: Thanks. Action items: Sam -> Figma frames + CSS export stub; Joy -> a11y checklist and sample alt text for exported images; Nina -> attach annotated screenshots. Target: include in next sprint grooming.
